description: A use child with validate: false skips schema validation (timeout_ms minimum: 0), so a negative timeout_ms reaches the compiler -- it is still Python-truthy (core/tool.py:519-520), so it resolves to a 1-second timeout rather than falling back to runtime.tools.timeout_seconds the way an explicit 0 does. A child that ignores SIGTERM and never exits on its own is killed once that 1-second budget elapses.
